title: Solo Leveling — Phase 2 Correspondence Map
status: principal correspondence and major adaptation-function map complete; Korean micro-locator backfill pending current-session EPUB remount

categories.Preserved: The source event, relationship, proposition, or causal function remains substantially intact.
categories.Compressed: Source material is shortened, summarized, or deprived of some interior, institutional, economic, or explanatory texture.
categories.Omitted: Source material with a meaningful local function is absent from the corresponding manhwa sequence.
categories.Expanded: The adaptation gives substantially more visual, relational, action, reaction, or temporal emphasis without changing the basic source function.
categories.Transformed: The source event remains recognizable but its emphasis, psychology, ethical framing, or thematic function changes materially.
categories.Relocated: Source material is moved to a different local position, volume, or dramatic context.
categories.Recomposed: Several source passages are rearranged, integrated, or cross-cut so that the resulting local sequence performs a materially different dramatic or thematic function.
categories.Manhwa-original: Material has no counterpart in the supplied Chugong prose corpus at the relevant level; includes the post-prose Suho continuation.
categories.Source-uncertain: The source relationship cannot presently be resolved beyond the stated zone without inventing precision; used especially where the raw Korean EPUB is not remounted.
